Definition: from G3470; to carp at, i.e. censure (discredit):--blame.
BiblicalUsage: Momaomai means to find fault, to blame — Paul gives no offence in anything, that the ministry be not blamed, and he takes care with the collection so no one can blame him over the money.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the care is part of the ministry: a blameless life keeps the gospel from being blamed.
